question: The more you take away from me, the bigger I become. What am I?
I have keys but open no locks. What am I?
I have hands but cannot clap. What am I?
I get wetter the more I dry. What am I?
I have one eye but cannot see. What am I?
I travel the world while staying in a corner. What am I?
I have many teeth but cannot bite. What am I?
I have a neck but no head. What am I?
I come down but never go up. What am I?
I have cities but no houses, rivers but no water. What am I?
I have legs but cannot walk. What am I?
I start with T, end with T, and have T inside. What am I?
I have words but never speak. What am I?
I have branches but no leaves or trunk. What am I?
I have many eyes but cannot see. What am I?
I have a thumb and four fingers but no life. What am I?
I am full of holes but still hold water. What am I?
I am easy to lift but hard to throw. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
I have one head, one foot, and four legs. What am I?
I am a room with no doors or windows. What am I?
I have roots that nobody sees. What am I?
I have endless letters but start empty. What am I?
Look right through me at a wall. What am I?
I am a tree you can carry in your hand. What am I?
I go through towns and over hills but never move. What am I?
I have many keys but only one lock. What am I?
I get shorter as I grow older. What am I?
I run around a yard without ever moving. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
I follow you all day but vanish in the dark. What am I?
I am a building with the most stories. What am I?
I have ears but cannot hear. What am I?
I have words but never talk. What am I?
I am black when clean and white when dirty. What am I?
I have no life but I can die. What am I?
I have a head and tail, am brown, and have no legs. What am I?
I begin with E and hold only one letter. What am I?
I go up and down without moving. What am I?
I am always answered but never ask. What am I?
I have no beginning, end, or middle. What am I?
I am easy to get into but hard to get out of. What am I?
I am bought to be eaten on but never eaten. What am I?
You can hear me but never see me. What am I?
I can be long, short, grown, or cut. What am I?
I am made of water but die in water. What am I?
The more you share me, the less you have. What am I?
I go up a chimney down but not down a chimney up. What am I?
I break the moment you say my name. What am I?
I have a bank but never sleep. What am I?
I float in the sky and bring the rain. What am I?
I have a tongue but cannot speak. What am I?
I carry my house on my back. What am I?
I show you yourself, but I am not you. What am I?
I twinkle in the night sky. What am I?
I glow at night and change my shape. What am I?
I rise in the east and set in the west. What am I?
I open locks and doors. What am I?
I can be opened but never closed. What am I?
I rise from fire but I am not the flame. What am I?
Feed me and I live, water me and I die. What am I?
You feel me but cannot see me. What am I?
I am a bird's little home. What am I?
Climb me step by step. What am I?
Rest your head on me at night. What am I?
I cross a river so you can walk over. What am I?
I am heavy and hold a ship in place. What am I?
I always point to the north. What am I?
Press me to fasten your shirt. What am I?
My pieces fit together to make a picture. What am I?
I appear in colors after the rain. What am I?
I am a mountain that erupts. What am I?
I am land surrounded by water. What am I?
I am dry, sandy, and have no water. What am I?
I am vast and full of salty water. What am I?
I rumble loudly after the lightning. What am I?
I flash bright across the sky. What am I?
I am white and fall softly in winter. What am I?
I fall from trees in autumn. What am I?
I am the part of a plant that is underground. What am I?
Bees make me and I am sweet. What am I?
I have eight legs and spin a web. What am I?
I am spun to catch flies. What am I?
I am tiny but very strong at picnics. What am I?
I am the biggest animal in the sea. What am I?
I am a bird with sharp eyes who flies high. What am I?
I am a big cat with stripes. What am I?
I cross the desert carrying humps. What am I?
I am a bird in a suit who cannot fly. What am I?
I am a mythical beast who breathes fire. What am I?
A king lives in me, with walls and towers. What am I?
A king wears me on his head. What am I?
A knight swings me in battle. What am I?
I block attacks in a fight. What am I?
I am gold and jewels hidden in a chest. What am I?
I attract iron to myself. What am I?
I am a machine made of metal that moves. What am I?
I blast off and fly into space. What am I?
I orbit the sun out in space. What am I?
I pull everything down to the ground. What am I?
